title: Constant labels and normalized signed Tate-line coordinates
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme in universe $u$, with small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. For a commutative ring $A$ in any universe $v$, define its constant label at $U$ to be the map $a\mapsto\iota_U(\operatorname{ULift}(a))$ into the constant ring sheaf of [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf], where $\iota$ is the constant-presheaf sheafification unit and the ring sheaf universe is $\max(v,u+1)$. This is purPointConstant. Separately let $R$ be any sheaf of commutative rings of universe $u+1$ on this site, and $L$ an $R$-module sheaf. Use the underlying ring sheaf purTwistRing of [def-pur-twist-coefficient-rings], the tensor powers and signed lines $L(s)$ of [def-coefficient-twists-detailed], and their tensor and internal Hom constructions [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product] and [def-pur-sheaf-hom]. For a family $c_s:R\simeq L(s)$ of module-sheaf isomorphisms, write $e_s=c_s(1)$. Define IsPurPointSignedCoordinates to mean the following section equations on every pro-etale test $U$: $c_0(b)=b$; $e_{r+2}=e_{r+1}\otimes e_1$ for every $r\geq0$, with the tensor section mapped through sheafification; $c_s(b)=b e_s$ for every integer $s$ and every $b\in R(U)$; $c_{r+1}^{-1}(b e_{r+1})=b$; for every local functional $\varphi\in L(-r-1)(U)$, $c_{-r-1}^{-1}(\varphi)=\varphi(e_{r+1})$; and $e_{-r-1}(e_{r+1})=1$. In the last two equations evaluation is at the identity object of the localized site $S_{\mathrm{proet}}/U$. This defines a predicate on the supplied family, asserts no existence, and imposes no point-scheme or field hypothesis.
